bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
want='ae1efae7152d3ae8c161e1a06bfb6f0bc6278e44483eeeaf6ad20432b44e5443'
echo GAYBBS_RUNNING="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
actual="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)"
echo GAYBBS_BUNDLE_SHA256="$actual"
test "$actual" = "$want"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo POSTGRES_RUNNING=PASS
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_ACTIVE=PASS
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT kind,state,COUNT(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY kind,state ORDER BY kind,state;"'
echo STARTLESS_DEPLOY_RUNTIME_READBACK=PASS
